Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. Draft TIA language below (concise for their DP team):

— TIA scope (draft) —
Systems covered: Redwood hosted inference API (production and staging endpoints tied to LuminaHealth org ids).
Categories of personal data: user-provided text and associated metadata (session ids, timestamps); customer identifiers required for billing. 
Processing activities: generation and temporary caching of model context for inference; no long-term storage of raw inputs by default (unless customer enables data persistence).
Retention and segregation: inference inputs cached up to 2 hours for KV cache optimization, persisted artifacts are retained per customer config; redwood offers a private deployment option for customers requiring complete on-prem data residency.
Security controls: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, per-customer logging streams (access controls and redaction policies available).
Fallback routing: in the event of cross-border constraints, routing to EU/UK-resident instances is supported under dedicated capacity or private deployment.

I'll attach a one-page TIA scope and the current subprocessor matrix. Jonas — can you confirm whether the default caching window (2 hours) and the tracing logs we produce are sufficient for Lumina's risk review, or whether they specifically need sampling/extracts?

Kimberly Park
Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: tia_scope_redwood_1p.pdf; subprocessor_matrix_v202706.xlsx

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCCs, UK-IDTA evidence & subprocessor matrix

Hi Priya / Jen —

On behalf of Engineering: short answers to likely technical asks before the sprint call: 

1) Logs & traces: we can provide redacted request-sampling exports (JSONL) for a bounded window and host an access-controlled view for Lumina security. Full raw payload exports are not enabled by default for hosted plans; private or dedicated deployments can meet that requirement.
2) Caching/KV: default caching is 2 hours; you can opt-out at the org level or enforce a 0-second cache for specific routes.
3) Encryption & key custody: AES-256 at rest; for private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key).
4) UK addendum vs UK IDTA: from a controls perspective we can accept either, but the IDTA is the stronger contractual commitment. If you require a signed UK IDTA we can initiate the DocuSign flow; otherwise the addendum attestation + operational evidence may be enough.

Proposed follow-up: we will upload the requested artifacts to a shared Drive and prepare a 30-min run-through on the 9 Jun call. Vanessa — please confirm whether Lumina confirmed 10:00 PT and I'll block the time.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
